Name: Nyapu Style Jonghyuk and Spanner (Sunberry Village NPCs)
Author: foureyedface
Description:
Portraits of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12000]Jonghyuk and Spanner [/url]based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's portrait mod

[/url]﻿Installation:
1. Have both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village [/url]and Jonghyuk and Spanner installed.
2. Download this mod.
3. Unzip this mod and drag the folder named "[CP] Jonghyuk" into your "Mods" folder.
4. When prompted, [i]replace all 37 files with the same names.[/i]

[i]Credits:[/i]
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Arknir27?gameId=1303]Arknir27 [/url]for the Jonghyuk and Spanner mod

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]skellady, sophiesalacia[/url] and the rest of the Sunberry team for Sunberry Village

If there are any issues feel free to leave a comment and/or message me.
